s: An unexpected file manager disappearance after upgrading to NixOS 25.05 (Warbler) on the unstable channel was resolved by explicitly adding 'nautilus' to system packages, highlighting potential package trimming in new releases and NixOS's powerful rollback capabilities.
sub: NixOS unstable channel upgrade (Vicuna to Warbler)
System hardening and package trimming as potential causes
Resolving the issue by adding 'gnome.nautilus' to configuration.nix
NixOS's declarative configuration and system rebuild process
